training_roles: Exactly381 development rows from the existing manifest, all previously consumed development. Aligned Expert C only. No filtered teacher target. No confirmation row assets opened, decoded, fitted or evaluated. No independent evaluation claim.
fivek_decode: Pinned normalized RGB uint16 TIFF loaded by tifffile, float32/65535, already display-encoded sRGB. No additional ICC conversion, gamma decoding or channel normalization. The source is prior generic RAW linear-sRGB then sRGB encoding; aligned Expert C is prior ProPhoto-to-D50-to-D65-to-sRGB, clipped/quantized after geometric normalization. These are digital expert edits, not film truth.
frame_coordinates: Resize each complete image to192 long edge by encoded-RGB bilinear antialias align_corners=False; center zero pad to192square with binary validity mask as fourth encoder channel. Same frame for paired target. Encoder three stride2/kernel3/pad1 convolutions have input-pixel feature centers0,8,16,... . Sample raw coefficient maps at valid-rectangle16x16 cell centers through this stride8 coordinate mapping, grid_sample bilinear/border/align_corners=False, BEFORE constraint/pooling. Resulting grid uses normalized UNPADDED whole-image coordinates; interpolate directly to valid rectangle for training or native HxW for inference, align_corners=False. Loss excludes padded pixels and weights each source equally. No crop augmentation, pixel whitening or fit-derived normalization.
coefficient_parameterization: a=tanh(raw_a); z=tanh(raw_RGB), centered=z-channelmean(z), b=.25*centered/max(1,max_channel_abs(centered)). Zero-sum balance and bounds are enforced per node. Local model uses all nodes. Global model takes spatial mean of constrained coefficients before rendering. Same architecture/seed/parameter count. Final head zero initializes exact identity; gradients to encoder begin after head update.
objective: Mean source-weighted masked RGB L1 to aligned Expert C plus .25 same loss for P(expert) versus expert. Add .001 nearest-neighbor squared coefficient differences and .0001 squared magnitude, averaged over source and expert predicted fields. F is frozen and absent from all training losses. No composed FilmSet-target loss and no response refit.
response_reuse: Reuse exact final shared-global checkpoint from48 FilmSet fit groups and600 updates, all3styles, trained with prior192square ICC-to-sRGB8 pipeline and its original curvature/fold regularizers. No checkpoint/style selection in this pilot. Preparation training is separate; call this modular transfer, not end-to-end jointly trained film.
controls: F(x), F(P_global(x)), F(P_local(x)), F(meanfield(P_local)(x)); meanfield is mean of constrained16x16 coefficients, no retraining or shifted field. Also save original, P_local, P_global. No optics or texture: identity stages, photometry only.
visual_rule: All4 fixed consumed challenge sources x all3 styles, whole images and original crop boxes. Developer rejection for severe face/text/content loss, bleaching, false color transitions or incoherent lighting. Candidate must visibly improve rich comfortable full appearance over F(x), trained global preparation and meanfield while retaining distinct style; enhancement alone or numeric FiveK gain is insufficient. Positive developer assessment only permits concrete human review. Keep128confirmation sealed until actual human visual feedback and separate admission. No parameter, checkpoint, style or step rescue.
claim_ceiling: Private development-only learned source preparation plus learned FilmSet-look response. No physically identified film stock, illumination decomposition, independent generalization, user preference, full-Fable or product acceptance claim. Fixed geometry/gamut bounds do not guarantee semantic preservation.
